name: port-command-trial
note: One trial of npm run port on one outside game. It is separate from the frozen campaign, and the guidance changed between runs.

runs.label: First port, before any guidance
runs.summary: Dash wired in updatePlayer: calls MotionDash.update once per tick with player as state and steering (left/right/jump as up), pre-offsets player.x/y by dx*5/dy*5 before updateEntity so tile collisions still run. S=5 gives 300px (~14.6% of 2048px width).

runs.label: Revised with a playtest note
runs.summary: Dash adds dash.dx*2/dash.dy*2 through position integration with collision checks extended to dash direction; 60*2=120px is ~5.9% of 2048px width, per-tick ~15px keeps normal+dash under one 32px tile.

patches.anchor:
entity.x  = entity.x  + (dt * entity.dx);
    entity.y  = entity.y  + (dt * entity.dy);

runs.label: Fresh port with early guidance
runs.summary: Dash wired in updateEntity for player only (S=2). Total 120px is ~5.9% of 2048px width, per-tick ~15px keeps normal+dash under one 32px tile so existing neighbour-cell walls stop it.

patches.anchor:
entity.x  = entity.x  + (dt * entity.dx);
    entity.y  = entity.y  + (dt * entity.dy);

runs.label: Revised with a second playtest note
runs.summary: Dash adds 2 units per source pixel through position with collision following dash direction when active.

patches.anchor:
entity.x  = entity.x  + (dt * entity.dx);
    entity.y  = entity.y  + (dt * entity.dy);

runs.label: Fresh port with final guidance, stopped at the output limit
runs.failure: Spark used its whole 10,000-token output limit and submitted nothing. The command now counts this as an attempt and retries.

runs.label: Fresh port with final guidance
runs.summary: Dash connected in updatePlayer with S=2 (120px = 5.9% of 2048px width). MotionDash.update called once per tick with steering; burst applied in 2px sub-steps with tile and map-edge collision per axis.

patches.replacement:
tcell    = function(tx,ty) { return cells[tx + (ty*MAP.tw)]; };
  var sim = {};

cells = data;
    sim = { cells: cells, player: player, monsters: monsters, treasure: treasure };
